# Mac Clamshell MCP

> Native Rust macOS MCP server, SEP-1865 side panel, CLI command wrapper, read-only AppleSMC fan telemetry (separating fan-control apps from monitors and reporting explicit SMC mode), external-display-safe closed-lid guard, adaptive build throttling, safe brightness control, and session-checked screen locking without sleeping background jobs.

## For AI Agents

- [AI Agent Guide & Full Reference](docs/ai-guide.md): Complete MCP tool schemas, CLI flags, throttle matrix, telemetry semantics, and LaunchAgent workflows.
- [Agent Skill](skills/mac-clamshell/SKILL.md): Throttling rules (`utility` / `eco` / `strict`), `mac-clamshell-mcp run` wrapping guidance, and MCP tool usage (`agentskills.io` compatible).
- [Contributor & Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Architecture, Cargo/panel test commands, security invariants, and plugin packaging rules.
- [README (English)](README.md) | [README (简体中文)](README.zh-CN.md)

## Quick Connect (Any MCP Client or Shell Agent)

Install the prebuilt macOS binary (Apple Silicon & Intel):
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

Generic stdio MCP configuration (`mcpServers`):
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mac-clamshell-mcp": {
      "command": "~/.gemini/config/plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/bin/mac-clamshell-mcp",
      "args": [
        "serve",
        "--data-dir", "~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/mac-clamshell-mcp",
        "--panel-html", "~/.gemini/config/plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/panel/dist/panel.html"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## MCP Tools

Public tools (all MCP sessions):
- `clamshell_panel` (`{ fresh?: boolean }`): Opens the live dashboard and reports lid, power, thermal, fan, display guard, and active throttle tier.
- `clamshell_set_brightness` (`{ percent: 0..100 }`): Sets built-in display brightness (`0`–`100%`) immediately when open, or updates wake-restore level while closed without lighting the screen.
- `clamshell_lock_screen` (`{}`): Locks the screen immediately without sleeping background jobs (call only when explicitly requested).

App-only tools (available only after SEP-1865 UI negotiation):
- `clamshell_refresh` (`{ ifHash?: string, force?: boolean, fresh?: boolean }`): ETag-deduplicated telemetry polling.
- `clamshell_configure` (`{ modeOverride?, maxJobsOverride?, acClosedProfile?, guardEnabled?, thermalBrightCapPct?, lang? }`): Persist policy, display guard, thermal cap, and language settings.

## CLI Subcommands

- `mac-clamshell-mcp status [--json]`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp run [--mode <auto|normal|utility|eco|strict>] [--jobs <n>] -- <cmd> [args...]`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp run --sh "<shell command>"`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp brightness get | set <0..100>`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp lock`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp guard install | uninstall | status`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp watch [--daemon] [--interval <secs>]`
